title: How ICAR’s List II and List III accreditation registers define valid degree scope for 2026 applicants
description: Understand the official ICAR NAEAB List II and List III accreditation workbooks and why unit-level validity dates matter for postgraduate and career eligibility.
summary: ICAR’s published List II (private colleges and universities) and List III (constituent/affiliated colleges of public general universities) record exact unit names, accredited programmes and validity windows that applicants must verify before admission.

sections.heading: What ICAR List II and List III actually record
paragraphs: The Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) publishes separate accreditation registers through its National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB). List II covers private agricultural colleges affiliated to State Agricultural Universities (such as [Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College](/university/adhiparasakthi-agricultural-college) and [SBVR Agricultural College](/university/sbvr-agricultural-college)) as well as private and deemed universities (such as [Lovely Professional University](/university/lovely-professional-university), [Centurion University of Technology and Management, Odisha](/university/centurion-university-of-technology-and-management) and [Vellore Institute of Technology](/university/vellore-institute-of-technology)).

List III records accredited constituent and affiliated colleges of public general universities, including [Udai Pratap College](/university/udai-pratap-college), [Khalsa College, Amritsar](/university/khalsa-college-amritsar) and [Tilak Dhari P.G. College, Jaunpur](/university/tilak-dhari-pg-college).

sections.heading: Checking programme name and validity period before paying fees
paragraphs: An institution’s presence in the ICAR workbook does not mean every course or every campus is accredited in perpetuity. Each row specifies the exact academic unit, the listed degree(s) and the five-year validity term. Read [how to check ICAR accreditation for an agriculture programme](/articles/icar-accreditation-how-to-check) for a step-by-step verification guide.

faqs.question: Why does ICAR accreditation matter for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture students?
faqs.answer: Many State Agricultural Universities and ICAR AIEEA-PG counselling brochures require graduates to hold a four-year degree from an ICAR-accredited institution/programme for postgraduate admission.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ICAR List II and List III?
faqs.answer: List II covers private colleges and private/deemed universities, while List III covers constituent and affiliated colleges of public general universities.
